summary_en:
The study tests PLT012, an anti-CD36 monoclonal antibody, in adults with advanced solid tumors. It is a Phase 1, first-in-human, open-label dose-escalation study with no placebo group.
PLT012 is given by intravenous infusion once every 3 weeks and continues until the disease worsens or the participant cannot tolerate it, with more frequent clinic visits during the first 12 weeks.
The study measures side effects and toxicities at different doses, blood levels of PLT012 over time, and effects on tumor size or cancer progression.
summary_es:
El estudio evalúa PLT012, un anticuerpo monoclonal anti-CD36, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. Es un estudio de Fase 1, de primera administración en humanos, abierto y de escalamiento de dosis, sin grupo de placebo.
PLT012 se administra por infusión intravenosa una vez cada 3 semanas y continúa hasta que la enfermedad empeore o el participante no pueda tolerarlo; durante las primeras 12 semanas las visitas a la clínica son más frecuentes.
El estudio mide los efectos secundarios y toxicidades con distintas dosis, los niveles de PLT012 en sangre a lo largo del tiempo y los efectos sobre el tamaño del tumor o la progresión del cáncer.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older who gave written informed consent.
Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced solid tumor, except primary CNS malignancies.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1.
Life expectancy of 12 weeks or more.
not_for: Ongoing grade 2 or higher toxicity from prior treatment, with some exceptions.
Another malignancy diagnosed within 2 years, with some exceptions.
Uncontrolled HIV, uncontrolled hepatitis B, or uncontrolled acute hepatitis C.
Unstable, uncontrolled, or untreated CNS metastasis.
Active or recent (within 3 years) autoimmune disease requiring medical treatment.
